title: Sandiganbayan denies Marcoleta’s bail | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Rodante Marcoleta, ICC, Social Good Summit

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Sandiganbayan denies Marcoleta’s bail request in plunder case

blocks.text: The Sandiganbayan 3rd Division denies the bail petition of Senator Rodante Marcoleta in his plunder case.

items: Agnes Callamard: US sanctions vs ICC could jeopardize Rodrigo Duterte case

blocks.text: Amnesty International secretary general and human rights activist Agnes Callamard warns US’ sanctions against the International Criminal Court could jeopardize the case of former president Rodrigo Duterte.

items: ‘A new imperial age’: Yuval Harari warns Philippines of foreign AI dependence

blocks.text: Historian and best-selling author Yuval Noah Harari warns AI could usher in a new age of empires and leave countries like the Philippines dependent on foreign powers.

items: Saudi Arabia’s influence loomed large over failed COP31 deal
